# OpenBayan Classical Arabic Corpus Engine

> High-performance scholarly search engine and crawlable reader for classical Islamic literature (Hadith, Fiqh, Tafsir, Aqeedah).

## Web Routes for Agents
- Search: `https://openbayan.mustaqbal.or.id/search?q={query}&category={category}&era={era}&tradition={tradition}`
- Passage Permalinks (HTML): `https://openbayan.mustaqbal.or.id/p/{chunk_id}`
- Passage Permalinks (Clean Markdown): `https://openbayan.mustaqbal.or.id/p/{chunk_id}.md`
- Dynamic Sitemap Index: `https://openbayan.mustaqbal.or.id/sitemap.xml`
- Full Corpus & Operator Specification: `https://openbayan.mustaqbal.or.id/llms-full.txt`

## Available Facet Filters
- `category`: `الفقه الشافعي`, `الفقه المالكي`, `شروح الحديث`, `كتب السنة`, `التفسير`, `العقيدة`
- `era`: `early` (<= 300 AH), `classical` (301-700 AH), `late` (>= 701 AH)
- `tradition`: `athari_salafi`, `classical_jumhur`

## Direct API Endpoints (JSON)
- Hybrid Search: `GET /api/v1/search?q={query}&mode=hybrid&limit=20`
- Surrounding Context: `GET /api/v1/chunks/{chunk_id}/surrounding`
- Chapter Stream: `GET /api/v1/books/{book_id}/sections/{section_id}/chunks`
- Telemetry & Analytics: `GET /api/v1/telemetry/stats`
